bestBets.overview: Seymour looks all clear leading through to its warm weekend so this Thursday card will be conducted on an improving track which - on Tuesday - was rated Soft 7. The rail is out 8 metres all the way. We open on what appears to be a very competitive mile Maiden, made up of mostly 3YOs. Guessing a bit with speed but that guess has me with 2 and 4 out front. DIESEL DIAMOND sets up just in behind and off a long break the 5YO looks just about ready to break on through. SKUA and ABAYA were 1st-up at 1400m and the extra furlong is positive (although probably the very least of what they'll be wanting distance-wise). Newcomer AEROSTATIQUE is unplaced from four jumpouts since May but hasn't been beaten far in two in August. Draws a treat here.

raceTips.comment:
Miss Waititi looked like she wanted to be outside horse on debut, so this gate may not be too bad.

Diesel Diamond stuck on well in the inferior going last start and is fit now.

Skua was entitled to flash late last start given the strong tempo up front. Further suits but a gap between runs rising in trip is a query.

bestBets.overview: Another good quality Maiden but can see a few of these wanting further. SHINY DIAMOND can hopefully jump away relatively clean and find a handy trailing spot. She copped a decent bump 250m from home 1st-up and was then right on heels late. 1100 to 1400m but sets up OK. ZOEHRER and RUSSIAN ROCK made solid debuts at Sandown Lakeside five months apart. Import HEDJET has been jumping out respectably. Two newcomers - ZVEREV has had a total of six jumpouts since February. Won his latest via leading on Heavy 10 for Blake Shinn at Cranbourne on August 24. ATTORNEY GENERAL has been seen in nine hitouts overall. Initially in Sydney, he has been at the tail in three recent jumpouts down here.

raceTips.comment:
Shiny Diamond only had one jump out going into his first-up run and he was dealt some significant interference there. That was over 1100m. Hia debut was over 1400m in a fast/high rating race. Suspect he can lead these and get a few out of their comfort zone. Would rather take better odds for his to place than the favourite to win.

Zoehrer is the obvious danger. Looks priced tight enough but she was good on debut in a strong maiden that has produced good form since.

Hedjet brings in a good last start rating from Ireland. Jump outs have been sufficient, but he is first-up off nearly a year off the fence.
